title: Detection profile
description: Describes one market: what is sold, which agents scan which sources, which qualification agents judge a lead, which scoring agents decide its score and verdict, how an aggregator sums it up and which contacts to prefer.

agents.description: Sourcing agents: they find leads. At least one is required unless the profile probes its own fingerprints or highlights job keywords.

language.title: Answer language
language.description: Language of every free-text field the LLM writes: triage reason, qualification summary, approach angle and draft. Evidence quotes stay in the source language.

qualification_agents.description: Qualification agents. Each one evaluates every lead of the profile from one angle. At least one is required.

scoring_agents.description: Scoring agents. Each one decides a score and a verdict for every lead from the reports of the qualification agents, through a contract imposed by the application. The lead score and verdict are the means of their answers weighted by the weight of each agent. With none enabled, the verdict stays pending.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: A sourcing agent, selected by type. A search agent looks for keywords across catalog providers, a certificates agent reads hostnames in certificate transparency logs, a DNS agent recognises providers by the CNAME target of hosts.

oneOf.title: Search agent
oneOf.description: Looks for keywords across one or several catalog providers. Keywords, exclusions and filters are defined once and every provider translates them into its own API, or applies them after collection when it cannot filter natively.

accept_min_keywords.description: Distinct keywords a candidate needs for a strong signal. Fewer, or any exclusion, still keeps the candidate with a weaker signal.

enabled.description: A disabled agent is kept but not run.

exclusions.description: Keywords that weaken the signal of a candidate when present. They never reject it: only a candidate without any keyword is rejected.

id.description: Unique slug in the profile, for example marches-publics.

providers.description: Catalog provider keys searched by this agent, for example boamp, decp, ted, france_travail or hacker_news_hiring. Each one must exist in the catalog and support keyword search. A provider that is not ready is skipped at run time.

oneOf.title: Certificates agent
oneOf.description: Reads new certificates in the certificate transparency logs. A hostname with one of the labels creates or updates a lead for its registrable domain.

enabled.description: A disabled agent is kept but not run.

id.description: Unique slug in the profile, for example certificats.

labels.description: Hostname labels to look for, for example auth or sso.

oneOf.title: DNS agent
oneOf.description: Resolves the CNAME chain of candidate hosts. A target matching a pattern creates or updates a lead for the registrable domain of the host.

enabled.description: A disabled agent is kept but not run.

id.description: Unique slug in the profile, for example dns.

AgentId.title: Agent id
AgentId.description: Slug identifying an agent in the profile.

Aggregator.title: Aggregator
Aggregator.description: Writes the summary of a lead from the answers of every qualification agent.

provider_id.description: Id of a declared LLM provider. The default provider applies when null.

system_prompt.description: System prompt given to the model.

CnamePattern.title: CNAME pattern
CnamePattern.description: A provider name with the CNAME target suffix that identifies it.

target_suffix.description: CNAME target suffix identifying the provider.

ContactRanking.title: Contact ranking
ContactRanking.description: Preferred email local parts, most preferred first.

guess_local_parts.description: Local parts to guess when no address is found.

preferred_local_parts.description: Preferred email local parts, most preferred first.

CustomInspection.title: Profile-specific fingerprints
CustomInspection.description: Fingerprints probed on the site of every lead of this profile, with the products to ignore and the extra subdomains to probe. A match becomes a product_detected or debt_marker signal.

excluded_products.description: Products to ignore, for example your own.

extra_subdomains.description: Subdomains of the lead domain probed as well, as hostname labels. Empty by default.

fingerprints.description: Fingerprints to probe on each host of a lead.

DebtMarker.title: Debt marker
DebtMarker.description: A technical debt signal raised when its rule holds.

version.description: Raised when the extracted version is lower than this one.

Enrichment.title: Enrichment
Enrichment.description: Settings of the inspection specific to this profile. Everything else is the same for every profile.

highlight_keywords.description: Keywords to highlight in the job offers of a lead. An offer with them becomes a job_offer signal. Empty means the keywords of the enabled search agents.

Escalation.title: Escalation
Escalation.description: Re-evaluates the leads whose confidence falls in a grey band with a stronger provider.

band_high.description: A lead is escalated below this confidence percentage. Default 70.

band_low.description: A lead is escalated from this confidence percentage. Must be lower than band_high. Default 40.

provider.description: Id of a declared LLM provider that re-evaluates the grey-zone leads. Escalation is disabled when null.

EvidenceSettings.title: Evidence settings
EvidenceSettings.description: How the strength of the evidence behind a lead (signals, sources, hosts) weighs on its confidence.

half_life_days.description: Half-life in days of a signal, by signal kind. A signal of that age counts for half in the volume and the strength of the evidence. The `default` key applies to every kind not listed; a kind that is not listed falls back to its built-in value.

influence.description: Confidence = agents opinion x ((1 - influence) + influence x evidence strength). 0 ignores the evidence, 1 multiplies the opinion by it.

EvidenceWeights.title: Evidence weights
EvidenceWeights.description: Relative weight of each component of the evidence strength. A weight of 0 ignores the component.

diversity.description: Number of distinct sources and signal kinds.

environment.description: Share of production hosts among the hosts carrying signals.

strength.description: Mean of the three strongest independent signals, each strength given by its source and decayed by its age.

volume.description: Number of independent signals, each decayed by its age.

Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
Fingerprint.description: A product fingerprint: path to request, matchers, optional version extractor and debt markers.

debt_markers.description: Technical debt signals for this product.

matchers.description: Conditions on the response. All must hold.

path.description: URL path to request, for example /login.

product.description: Product name raised as a signal.

version.description: Optional extractor for the product version.

Identity.title: Identity
Identity.description: The offer and the target customer, in free text.

offer.description: What is sold, in free text.

target_customer.description: Who buys it, in free text.

Inspection.title: Ecosystem inspection
Inspection.description: Every lead with a registrable domain gets the same ecosystem inspection, whatever the profile: official identity, legal life, public contracts, site and technical stack, DNS and e-mail, hiring and recent activity. The qualification agents read what it finds and decide what matters.

enabled.description: When false, the leads of the profile are not inspected and qualification does not wait for the inspection. Default true.

Matcher.title: Matcher
Matcher.description: A condition on the HTTP response.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the header value.
Regular expression matched against the body.

QualificationAgent.title: Qualification agent
QualificationAgent.description: Evaluates every lead of the profile from one angle by asking a model a list of questions.

description.description: What this agent evaluates, in one sentence, for example the technical maturity of the lead.

enabled.description: A disabled agent is kept but not run.

exclusion_threshold.description: Probability from 0.5 to 1 at which a grounded answer for an option that excludes the lead excludes it. Default 0.6.

id.description: Unique slug among all agents of the profile, sourcing and qualification, for example maturite-technique.

learned_calibration.description: When true, once at least 50 leads are labelled with 10 of each class, the score of this agent is corrected by an isotonic map learned daily from the human decisions. The fit always runs so the quality page keeps its figures. Default true.

provider_id.description: Id of a declared LLM provider. The default provider applies when null.

questions.description: Questions the agent answers. At least one is required.

samples.description: Number of independent model calls per lead, from 1 to 5. The answer of each question is the majority choice. Default 3.

sampling_temperature.description: Temperature of the calls when samples is above 1, overriding the provider temperature. Default 0.7.

system_prompt.description: System prompt given to the model.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: A multiple choice question a qualification agent answers about a lead.

id.description: Identifier unique in the agent, used as the answer key.

options.description: Possible answers, from 2 to 11, with unique values. Exactly one of them is the unknown option.

weight.description: Integer weight from 1 to 10 of this question in the agent score.

wording.description: The question asked to the model.

QuestionOption.title: Question option
QuestionOption.description: One possible answer to a question and the score it is worth.

excludes.description: When true, a grounded answer for this option at or above the agent's exclusion threshold excludes the lead. Never set on the unknown option.

is_unknown.description: Marks the unknown option, chosen when nothing in the documents supports an answer. Exactly one option per question carries it.

score.description: Score from 0 to 1 of this answer.

value.description: Value the model answers, unique in the question.

RemoteFilter.title: Remote filter
RemoteFilter.description: any keeps every candidate, full_remote keeps fully remote ones, remote_or_hybrid keeps remote and hybrid ones.

ScoringAgent.title: Scoring agent
ScoringAgent.description: Decides the score and the verdict of every lead from the reports of the qualification agents. The shape of its answer is imposed by the application: criteria choices, a score from 0 to 100, probabilities for each verdict and reasons.

criteria.description: Criteria the agent answers before it scores. Same rules as qualification questions, except that no option can exclude a lead. At least one is required.

description.description: What this agent evaluates, in one sentence.

enabled.description: A disabled agent is kept but not run.

id.description: Unique slug among all agents of the profile, sourcing, qualification and scoring, for example score-global.

learned_calibration.description: When true, once at least 50 leads are labelled with 10 of each class, the verdict probabilities of this agent are corrected by an isotonic map learned daily from the human decisions. The fit always runs so the quality page keeps its figures. Default true.

provider_id.description: Id of a declared LLM provider. The default provider of the aggregator tier applies when null.

samples.description: Number of independent model calls per lead, from 1 to 5. The criteria are voted, the score and the verdict probabilities are averaged. Default 1.

sampling_temperature.description: Temperature of the calls when samples is above 1, overriding the provider temperature. Default 0.7.

system_prompt.description: System prompt given to the model.

weight.description: Integer weight from 1 to 10 of this agent in the lead score and verdict. It only matters when the profile has two or more scoring agents.

SearchFilters.title: Search filters
SearchFilters.description: Criteria shared by every provider of a search agent. A provider filters natively what its API supports and the rest is applied on the candidate text after collection.

contracts.description: Accepted contract types. Empty, or any, means every contract type.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, uppercase, for example FR. Empty means every country.

VerdictThresholds.title: Verdict thresholds
VerdictThresholds.description: Rules that decide the verdict of a lead from its confidence: reliable, to check or discarded.

calibration_floor.description: Each answer probability is clamped to [floor, 1 - floor] then renormalised before scoring, so a small model cannot claim absolute certainty. 0 disables the calibration.

discard_below.description: A lead is discarded below this confidence percentage. Must be lower than reliable_from.

min_evidence.description: A lead is reliable only when its evidence strength (0 to 1) reaches this value.

reliable_from.description: A lead is reliable from this confidence percentage, provided it also has two independent angles and enough evidence.

VersionExtractor.title: Version extractor
VersionExtractor.description: Extracts a product version from the response. The pattern needs a capture group.

pattern.description: Regular expression with a capture group for the version.
Regular expression with a capture group for the version.
